segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, very dry, or dehydrated skin are the most common voice and consistently describe the cream as deeply and lastingly hydrating, especially useful in winter or dry climates.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin generally report no irritation and value that the formula is genuinely fragrance-free, though one reviewer attributes a case of perioral dermatitis to extended use.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination or combination-oily skin find the cream hydrating without breakouts, though a few find it too rich for the oilier T-zone in summer.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe their skin as mature or aging report a firmer, plumper look and softer fine lines alongside the hydration.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, including many with dry or very dry skin, report intense, long-lasting hydration and a visibly plumper, softer complexion; a smaller group finds the rich texture leaves a tacky or greasy after-feel that limits it to nighttime or winter use, and one reviewer felt it never fully absorbed.
concerns.aging: Several reviewers report smoother fine lines and a firmer, more toned look after a few weeks of use, though this is usually mentioned as a secondary benefit alongside hydration rather than the main effect.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer attributes a case of perioral dermatitis to extended use of the cream, while many others, including reviewers with sensitive or acne-prone skin, report no breakouts or irritation and describe it as calming.

aspects.libelle: Too heavy for daytime or under makeup
Good value, a little goes a long way

extraits.texte: I used the normal formula (not the rich one) for some time and i always had dryness around my mouth i just thought it was normal for my skin or a reaction to retinal too close to sensitive areas. My skin was so dry from winter air i decided to try to rich formula in April. My skin developed little red bumps, it was so dry and itchy around my mouth. I was traveling a lot and just thought it was a change in atmosphere, toothpaste or again my actives. My last order broke in the mail and I had to use a different moisturizer temporarily. Blessing in disguise - the red bumps are gone and my barrier is healing. All this to say I believe this moisturizer was causing my perioral dermatitis.

I used this product in the morning and at night for about 10 days prior to this review. I love that it is truly fragrance free. I am also very impressed that I have been using a hyaluronic acid cream for 10 days and my skin shows zero sign of peeling or dryness. I have not had that experience in the past. That being said, this product is very tacky on my skin. I could not wear it during the day without putting makeup on over it. It does help my makeup stay on all day, though! At night it isn't much of an issue because I put it on right before I got to bed. At this point I am not seeing reduction in fine lines, but I will continue to use it until the jar is gone before I make a final decision.

If you have dry and sensitive skin, this is the product for you! I've tried a lot of moisturizers in high, low, and luxury price ranges and this product is simple and reliable! It doesn't have any irritants and my sensitive skin really enjoyed it. It kept my skin very hydrated throughout the day. I also really love that this product is fragrance free!

This is a great choice for dry, sensitive, or compromised skin. It's reliable, clean, and genuinely nourishing. While not ideal for oily skin, it's a top-tier option for anyone needing lasting hydration and barrier repair. I've been using this every night to keep my skin hydrated from the summer sun, and plan to use morning and night since my skin gets extra dry in the winter.

Sensitive, acne-prone, combination skin here. I can't believe how lucky I got purchasing this on a whim. The amount in the container is a decent amount for the money, but even moreso for the fact that it is so rich that you do not need a lot. I needed a deeply moisturizing cream for my face after my hormones changed after I turned 30, but others I've tried either broke me out with acne or I became allergic to them. This product doesn't cause me breakouts or allergic reactions. I slather it on at night and then the next morning, I can get away with washing my face with only water and it provides the best long-lasting hydration all through the next day. It is incredible. Highly recommend!

extraits.titre: Lovely cream - rich but also light and absorbent
extraits.texte: This cream feels very luxurious and nourishing. It's a rich cream but it doesn't feel thick or heavy on the skin. It absorbs beautifully. I found this the perfect cream to layer between serum and SPF - I've been using it as my day cream and find it layers great under SPF and makeup. I have mature skin that leans dry so I most enjoy skincare that provides real, long lasting moisture and locks in hydration and this is a pretty darn perfect option for that. I also love the glass packaging. All in all I'm very happy and will continue to use this lovely cream.

Well I can say I will be definitely be buying this moisturizer again. I love it because it has very little scent, silky smooth. Im 59 and im always looking for a moisturizer for mature skin, this leaves my skin soft.
